summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor (checks only is_terminal, returns False without buffering otherwise); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Per instructions, no tests were run and nothing was committed; verification was by reading only.
